title: Check preview worker health
responsibility: Authenticates private worker health probes, observes repeated server failures and reports whether project agents are active.

inputs.name: previewHealth.token
inputs.description: Token expected in the `x-harness-worker` header for this plugin instance. It is checked only for GET requests whose URL exactly equals `/__harness_worker__`; a missing or nonmatching value is denied with HTTP 403.

inputs.name: readPreviewHealth.url
inputs.description: Base URL used to form the probe request; `/__harness_worker__` is concatenated directly before calling `fetch`. The function does not normalize the URL, so any trailing slash remains part of the requested URL.

inputs.name: readPreviewHealth.token
inputs.description: Value sent in the `x-harness-worker` header for this probe. It must match the token passed to the worker's `previewHealth` plugin or the endpoint responds with HTTP 403, which causes this reader to reject.

outputs.name: closePreviewSessions
outputs.description: Calls `close()` on every value in the shared session map at `Symbol.for('harness.console.agents')`, if the map exists. It returns no value and does not await any subsequent cancellation.

outputs.name: previewHealth
outputs.description: Creates a Vite pre middleware for the exact `/__harness_worker__` URL and reports the process id, a per-plugin count of 5xx responses on other URLs, and whether any shared agent session is busy. Only GET requests with the exact `x-harness-worker` token receive no-store JSON; other methods or tokens receive 403, and the failure count resets to one after a 30-second gap.

outputs.name: readPreviewHealth
outputs.description: Resolves to the worker's JSON health object with protocol marker `harness-worker-v1`, process id, observed 5xx count, and busy flag. It accepts only an OK response with that protocol marker and does not runtime-validate the other field values.

errors.name: WorkerNotReadyError
errors.description: Throws `WorkerNotReadyError('Worker not ready.')` when the response is not OK or its protocol is not `harness-worker-v1`. Fetch, redirect, 750 ms timeout, and JSON parsing failures also reject the promise; the remaining health fields are not runtime-validated.
